params.user: the account whose greeting was updated

InvalidMessage(string).notice: happen when trying to set an invalid greeting

MessageChanged(address,string).notice: emitted whenever a user updates their greeting

setMessage(string).notice: called to set your own greeting

userdoc.notice: let user set a greeting A greeting belongs to the account that sent it: every write reads `msg.sender` and files the greeting under it, so the sender and the greeter are always the same address. The registry keeps one greeting per account, and threads them into a list so the most recent ones can be read back in order without an indexer.
